=== SnapinReplicator :: globally disabled ===
log=/var/log/fogcustom/fogsnapinrep.log dev=/dev/tty4 zzz=600
  [wlog groupmanager.log]  * Checking if I am the group manager.
   *  * Snapin replication is globally disabled
  [serviceRun end]

=== SnapinReplicator :: storage group has gone ===
log=/var/log/fogcustom/fogsnapinrep.log dev=/dev/tty4 zzz=600
  [wlog groupmanager.log]  * Checking if I am the group manager.
  [wlog groupmanager.log]  * I am the group manager
   * Skipping, no such storage group: 3
  [serviceRun end]

=== SnapinReplicator :: nothing enabled to replicate ===
log=/var/log/fogcustom/fogsnapinrep.log dev=/dev/tty4 zzz=600
  [wlog groupmanager.log]  * Checking if I am the group manager.
  [wlog groupmanager.log]  * I am the group manager
   * Starting Snapin Replication.
   * We are group ID: 3. We are group name: GroupOne
   * We are node ID: 7. We are node name: NodeSeven
   * Attempting to perform Group -> Group snapin replication.
  [getIds snapin field=- find={"isEnabled":[1],"toReplicate":[1]}]
   | There are no snapins available!.
  [serviceRun end]

=== SnapinReplicator :: enabled but nothing associated ===
log=/var/log/fogcustom/fogsnapinrep.log dev=/dev/tty4 zzz=600
  [wlog groupmanager.log]  * Checking if I am the group manager.
  [wlog groupmanager.log]  * I am the group manager
   * Starting Snapin Replication.
   * We are group ID: 3. We are group name: GroupOne
   * We are node ID: 7. We are node name: NodeSeven
   * Attempting to perform Group -> Group snapin replication.
  [getIds snapin field=- find={"isEnabled":[1],"toReplicate":[1]}]
  [getCount snapingroupassociation find={"storagegroupID":3,"snapinID":[11,22]}]
   | There is nothing to replicate.
   | Please physically associate snapins to a storage group.
  [serviceRun end]

=== SnapinReplicator :: two items, one primary to this group ===
log=/var/log/fogcustom/fogsnapinrep.log dev=/dev/tty4 zzz=600
  [wlog groupmanager.log]  * Checking if I am the group manager.
  [wlog groupmanager.log]  * I am the group manager
   * Starting Snapin Replication.
   * We are group ID: 3. We are group name: GroupOne
   * We are node ID: 7. We are node name: NodeSeven
   * Attempting to perform Group -> Group snapin replication.
  [getIds snapin field=- find={"isEnabled":[1],"toReplicate":[1]}]
  [getCount snapingroupassociation find={"storagegroupID":3,"snapinID":[11,22]}]
  [getIds snapingroupassociation field=snapinID find={"storagegroupID":3,"snapinID":[11,22]}]
  [getList snapin]
   | Replicating CA
  [replicateItems group=3 node=7 item=FOG\Snapin#0 primary=no path=ssl/CA]
  [replicateItems group=3 node=7 item=FOG\Snapin#11 primary=yes path=-]
   | Not syncing Snapin: item22
   | This is not the primary group.
   * Attempting to perform Group -> Nodes snapin replication.
  [replicateItems group=3 node=7 item=FOG\Snapin#11 primary=no path=-]
  [replicateItems group=3 node=7 item=FOG\Snapin#22 primary=no path=-]
  [serviceRun end]
